title: rswa-world-heavyweight
label: Bruno Sammartino

won.source: The fed's own 22 January 1990 title-lineage notes name him reigning champion ("World Heavyweight Champion: Bruno Samartino (who else...really?)"); no win date survives.

how: The record does not say how the title was first won.
note: Retained against Andre the Giant in the Memphis card's own triple main event, 22 January 1990 (rswa-1990-01-22); billed to defend again against Curt Hennig on the announced Tampa card, whose own results do not survive.

title: rswa-world-tag-team
label: The Valiant Brothers

won.source: The fed's own 22 January 1990 title-lineage notes name them reigning champions ("World Tag-Team Champions: The Vallian Brothers"); no win date survives.

how: The record does not say how the title was first won.
note: Absent from the Memphis card (22 January 1990): the same title-lineage notes explain they were injured by the Road Warriors after retaining the titles, following interference from their own manager, who the same post says was left "serious but out of danger" — an in-fiction event that predates the surviving record and has no show of its own to attach an appearance to. Billed to defend against Stan Hansen and Terry Gordy in a cage on the announced Tampa card; results do not survive.
